fusions.name: Roll It Under
fusions.desc: Sets the barb and rolls, dealing 16 damage and tearing out every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Snap From Stillness
fusions.desc: Lunges through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to everything caught in it. Every hit is a critical hit and clamps the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Baited Waterline
fusions.desc: Sets a baited barb at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 40 seconds and deals 22 damage to each of the first 2 enemies to come within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Log in the Shallows
fusions.desc: Anything you strike moves 20% slower for 3 seconds. When your stamina is full, your physical damage rises 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
